evidence: The supply-chain mapping now requires inventory, pinning, hash or signature verification, approval, and rollback for every model, adapter, prompt/template, tool definition, skill, and package dependency, and the poisoning mapping adds integrity validation and change/anomaly monitoring of every authorized training, fine-tuning, and retrieval source, stating that an ACL says who may read a source, not that its content is unpoisoned (commit b21e253).
